## Solución

```{r}
# X ~ Poi(5)
lambda <- 5
k <- 0:30
pk <- dpois(k, lambda)

# E(X) manual
EX <- sum(k * pk)
# E(X^2)
EX2 <- sum(k^2 * pk)
# Var(X) = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2
VarX <- EX2 - EX^2

cat("E(X)   =", round(EX, 4), "\n")
cat("Var(X) =", round(VarX, 4), "\n")
cat("sd(X)  =", round(sqrt(VarX), 4), "\n")
```
